description: Agent Food Safety Records: submit food recall and lot traceability records with the inventory, mock recall and supplier notice records they answer to: each traceability shipment with its id, reference, the lot code shipped and the customer; each recall with its id, reference, the lot codes recalled, the customers its distribution list names and the moment it began; each inventory record entry with its id, the lot code, its status (on_hand, shipped, held, destroyed or returned) and the moment recorded; each mock recall with its id, reference, the lot traced, the moments the trace began and was completed, the trace time the result claims, the trace time the program allows and the result claimed; each supplier recall notice with its id, reference, supplier and the lot codes named; each hold or disposition with its id, reference, the notice, the lot code and the action. The signed report gives the recalls and the inventory, each recall’s distribution list against the customers the traceability records ship its lots to, each recalled lot against what the inventory record shows, each mock recall’s claimed result against its recorded trace times, and each supplier recall notice against a hold or disposition record, and counts them, and names divergent recall records: a recall whose recorded distribution list does not match the traceability records, a recalled lot the inventory record still shows on hand or shipped, a mock-recall result the records claim that the recorded trace times do not support, and a supplier recall notice with no hold or disposition record behind it; then a recall or shipment naming a lot the inventory record does not hold and a hold naming a notice the records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No recalls, mock recalls or notices, a recall with no shipments beside it, or a mock recall with no trace times on the clock leaves those points unverified. Lots, recalls, shipments, notices and holds match by letters and digits, customers compare without case, punctuation or company endings, a recalled lot reads as moved when the inventory shows it on hand or shipped on or after the recall began, and a mock recall is timed from start to completion on the clock. This reads food recall and lot traceability records: wever_auto-recall-check reads vehicle recall campaigns and completions, while the recall check reads where each recalled lot went, what the inventory still shows and whether every supplier notice was held. Verdict food_recall_divergent, food_recall_partial, food_recall_unverified or food_recall_consistent. POST /api/food-recall-check. Reads the food safety records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it inspects no facility, takes no temperature, contacts no regulator or auditor and issues no certification, which stay with the business, its food safety team, its regulators and its auditors, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Food Safety Records reads a food business’s own safety records: food safety and HACCP plan records, critical-control-point and temperature monitoring logs, health inspection and third-party audit reports, recall and traceability records, supplier approval and receiving records, sanitation records, allergen and labeling records and corrective action records, each against the monitoring, inspection and corrective-action records, the corrective actions and the schedule, the plan’s limits and equipment, the lot traceability and inventory records, the supplier approvals and certificates, the cleaning schedule and safety data sheets, the formulation and production records or the deviations and verifications on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the food: what the plan requires, what the logs show, what the inspectors found, and whether the fixes and the traceability hold up; the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods as trade records, and the Agent Automotive family reads vehicle records, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-food-safety-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-food-safety-records/.
